messages:
Jamal (Acme Integrations): hey @support — after today's canary (model=v2) our ingest started failing. parser throws KeyError: 'order_id'. started ~10:12am ET. attaching example request/response.

Deploy Bot: deploy finished: canary rollout model=redwood-v2-structured -> 10% @ 2026-03-17T10:11:30Z :rocket:

Maya (CS): thanks Jamal — can you paste the exact response body you're getting and the JSON schema you expect? is this only for Acme or other partners too?

Jamal (Acme Integrations): expected schema (simplified):
```json
{
  "order_id": "string",
  "customer": { "id": "string" },
  "items": [ { "sku": "string", "qty": "integer" } ],
  "billing": { "currency": "string", "country": "string" }
}
```
actual response we receive (from Redwood API response field `structured_output`):
```json
{
  "customer": { "id": "C-9921" },
  "items": [ { "sku": "X-123", "qty": 1 } ],
  "billing": { "country": "US" }
}
```
note: `order_id` missing entirely, `billing.currency` missing. before 10:12 we always got `order_id` present even when empty string.

Devon (Integrations): can repro locally with a short prompt. quick curl we used:
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-structured","prompt":"Extract order JSON from text","response_format":"json_schema","temperature":0.0}'
```
I see the same behavior: keys with empty or null values are being omitted. This started when `redwood-v2-structured` was introduced.

Priya (SRE): signal check: structured-output schema-mismatch errors jumped at 2026-03-17T10:12 from baseline 0.12% -> 4.6% across prod; ~85% of affected requests served by redwood-v2-structured canary. latency unchanged. rolling error rate per-route in /ingest/partner-acme.

Maya (CS): tagging eng-ml for root cause @Emma, this is P0 for the customer. Jamal — we can offer immediate mitigation while we triage.

Emma (eng-ml): looking. We shipped a change in the schema-serializer in v2: we now prune keys with null/empty values to save tokens. That was intentional to reduce cost, but it violates strict-schema expectations for some customers. The change landed in the v2 canary surface this morning.

Emma (eng-ml): options: 1) revert prune behavior (hotfix) — quick but affects token costs; 2) expose `keep_null_fields=true` routing flag on the API and set it for customers needing strict schema; 3) surface a runtime prompt override we can inject for partners to force presence of keys.

Jamal (Acme Integrations): we need `order_id` present (can be null) — our parser expects fixed keys. workaround OK for now if you can force keys on our route.

Devon (Integrations): short-term workaround proven: include an explicit system instruction in the request: "system": "Always output the JSON object with all schema keys. If a value is missing, set it to null." and `temperature: 0`. That yields the full set in my local test. Not ideal to ask customers to change prompts though.

Emma (eng-ml): agreed. I'll prepare a hotfix to re-enable keep-nulls as default for the canary group and push an API flag the PM can gate for selected customers. Will request rollback window if hotfix isn't fast enough.

Ravi (Product): need customer-facing comms. Maya, can you draft a note explaining regression + ETA for hotfix/rollback? We'll also offer Acme a temporary route-level override.

Maya (CS): on it. Jamal — apologies, we'll enable a route override for Acme and follow up with timeline. :pray:

Deploy Bot: action: canary paused for model=redwood-v2-structured at 2026-03-17T10:20:10Z by eng-ml.

Priya (SRE): rolling rollback prepared: target revert commit `serializer/keep-nulls:off->on` staged for 10:30 UTC. impact minimal.

Jamal (Acme Integrations): appreciated. We'll keep monitoring and will accept the route override. please confirm when done.

Emma (eng-ml): route override enabled for `partner-acme` at 2026-03-17T10:25:00Z. Please validate.

Jamal (Acme Integrations): confirmed — ingest now shows `order_id: null` when missing. parser OK. thanks all.

Maya (CS): closing loop: root cause = v2 serializer prune-nulls change; remediation = route override + planned hotfix/flag. follow-up postmortem planned. :white_check_mark:
